content.short: Tethys Finance is a native perpetual and spot DEX on Metis featuring high leverage and automated yield vaults.
content.description:
Tethys Finance is a premier decentralized exchange and perpetual futures platform built natively on the Metis Andromeda Layer 2 network. Utilizing an advanced GMX-style architecture, the protocol features the Tethys Liquidity Pool (TLP), an index of major assets that enables users to engage in leveraged trading with up to 50x leverage. This ensures that participants can execute complex trading strategies with deep liquidity and minimal slippage in a fully non-custodial environment.

Beyond its core trading capabilities, Tethys offers automated yield-bearing products and leveraged farming tools to maximize capital efficiency for its users. The platform is designed for professional-grade performance and high throughput, leveraging Metis's scalable infrastructure for low-cost and secure on-chain execution. As a cornerstone of the Metis DeFi landscape, Tethys Finance is dedicated to providing the essential financial infrastructure needed for participants to build and manage sophisticated decentralized portfolios with unparalleled ease and security.
